camel_example: aliyun paillmtrace PUT /api/v1/PAILLMTrace/onlineevaltasks/518bc0f833d9a4ad3836ace4db69ba59c --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body {"Filters":[{"Operator":"=_StartsWith_Contains","Value":"foo","Key":"ServiceId_ServiceName_Input_Output_Status_TraceType_SpanType_TraceName_SpanName"}],"ModelConfig":"example-string","Description":"这个任务做了这些事。","EndTime":"2024-09-02_22:24:00","TaskName":"foo大模型应用效果评估","EvaluationConfig":"example-string","StartTime":"2024-07-31_08:30:00","SamplingRatio":50,"SamplingFrequencyMinutes":10,"AppName":"my-llm-one"}
description_en: Changes the configuration of a trace evaluation task
description_zh: 更改一个链路评估任务的配置
kebab_example: aliyun paillmtrace update-online-eval-task --task-id 518bc0f833d9a4ad3836ace4db69ba59c --task-name 'foo大模型应用效果评估' --app-name my-llm-one --filters Operator==_StartsWith_Contains Value=foo Key=ServiceId_ServiceName_Input_Output_Status_TraceType_SpanType_TraceName_SpanName --start-time 2024-07-31_08:30:00 --end-time 2024-09-02_22:24:00 --sampling-frequency-minutes 10 --sampling-ratio 50 --description '这个任务做了这些事。' --evaluation-config example-string --model-config example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateOnlineEvalTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the trace evaluation task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The user-defined name of the LLM application
parameters.help_zh: 用户的基于大模型的应用的名称
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The end time of the trace data, in UTC format
parameters.name: end_time

fields.help_en: The JSON path where the Answer is stored in the trace log
fields.help_zh: 链路log里存放Answer的json path
fields.name: json_path_in_span

fields.help_en: If the value retrieved at the JSON path is itself a JSON string, a further JSON path must be defined within this JSON to obtain the actual value
fields.help_zh: 如果json path处取到的值本身仍然是json string，那么需要进一步定义这个json里的json path以获取实际的值
fields.name: json_path_in_span_value

fields.help_en: The span name in the trace log
fields.help_zh: 链路log的span名称
fields.name: span_name

fields.help_en: The answer to the user's question from the LLM application
fields.help_zh: 基于大语言模型的应用针对用户问题的回答
fields.name: answer

fields.help_en: The JSON path where the Context is stored in the trace log
fields.help_zh: 链路log里存放Context的json path
fields.name: json_path_in_span

fields.help_en: If the value retrieved at the JSON path is itself a JSON string, a further JSON path must be defined within this JSON to obtain the actual value
fields.help_zh: 如果json path处取到的值本身仍然是json string，那么需要进一步定义这个json里的json path以获取实际的值
fields.name: json_path_in_span_value

fields.help_en: The span name in the trace log
fields.help_zh: 链路log的span名称
fields.name: span_name

fields.help_en: The context node information referenced when the model answers a question
fields.help_zh: 大模型回答问题时参考的上下文节点信息
fields.name: context

fields.help_en: The JSON path where the Query is stored in the trace log
fields.help_zh: 链路log里存放Query的json path
fields.name: json_path_in_span

fields.help_en: If the value retrieved at the JSON path is itself a JSON string, a further JSON path must be defined within this JSON to obtain the actual value
fields.help_zh: 如果json path处取到的值本身仍然是json string，那么需要进一步定义这个json里的json path以获取实际的值
fields.name: json_path_in_span_value

fields.help_en: The span name in the trace log
fields.help_zh: 链路log的span名称
fields.name: span_name

fields.help_en: The question from the user to the LLM application
fields.help_zh: 用户向基于大语言模型的应用提出的问题
fields.name: query

parameters.help_en: This configuration structure defines the JSON paths needed to extract specific values from trace data in JSON format. EvaluationConfig defines these JSON paths
parameters.help_zh: 从json格式的链路数据里要一些提取特定路径上的值，作为评估操作的输入。在这个EvaluationConfig结构体里定义这些json路径
parameters.name: evaluation_config

fields.example:
ServiceId
ServiceName
Input
Output
Status
TraceType
SpanType
TraceName
SpanName
fields.help_en:
The key of the filter condition.

Valid values:

Status
SpanName
Input
TraceType
SpanType
ServiceName
Output
TraceName
ServiceId
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件的key
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The matching operator of the filter condition.

Valid values:

Contains
\=
StartsWith
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件匹配操作符
fields.name: operator

fields.help_en: The value of the filter condition
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件的值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The evaluation task must search for a certain amount of trace data generated by the user application as input data for the evaluation. This list defines the search filter conditions
parameters.help_zh: 评估任务要搜索一定量的用户应用产生的链路数据，作为评估操作的输入数据。这是定义搜索筛选条件的列表
parameters.name: filters

fields.help_en: The authentication key required when the evaluation task calls a model which the user has permission to use, acting under the user's name
fields.help_zh: 评估任务需要以用户名义调用用户有使用权的大模型时，需要填充的认证key
fields.name: api_key

fields.help_en: The model service endpoint required when the evaluation task calls the model
fields.help_zh: 评估任务需要以用户名义调用用户有使用权的大模型时，需要填充的模型服务地址
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en: Whether the model service is provided by the user (True), or by Alibaba Cloud PAI (False)
fields.help_zh: 用户的大模型服务是自己提供的(True)、还是阿里云PAI提供的(False)
fields.name: is_self_host

fields.help_en: The model name
fields.help_zh: 大模型的名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: Controls the randomness of the model output. Maximum value: 0.2
fields.help_zh: 控制大模型输出随机性的温度参数。最大可设置到0.2
fields.name: temperature

fields.help_en: Controls the randomness of the model output
fields.help_zh: 控制大模型输出随机性的top p参数
fields.name: topp

fields.help_en: Whether the model is allowed to use external tools
fields.help_zh: 评估任务需要以用户名义调用用户有使用权的大模型时，是否允许大模型调用外部工具
fields.name: use_function_call

parameters.help_en: The access configuration structure of the model used in the evaluation
parameters.help_zh: 评估任务内部使用的大模型的访问配置结构体
parameters.name: model_config

parameters.help_en: The evaluation task must search for a certain amount of trace data generated by the user application as input data for the evaluation. This is the width of the time window for each search of input data
parameters.help_zh: 评估任务要搜索一定量的用户应用产生的链路数据，作为评估操作的输入数据。这是定义任务每次搜索输入数据的时间窗口的宽度
parameters.name: sampling_frequency_minutes

parameters.help_en: The percentage of data found in a time window that truly serves as evaluation input data. For example, 100 indicates that all data searched is used as evaluation input. 20 indicates that 20% of the found data is randomly selected as evaluation input
parameters.help_zh: 评估任务在一个时间窗口里搜索到的数据，真正作为评估输入数据的百分比。比如100表示搜索到的所有数据都作为评估输入。又比如20表示从搜索到的数据里随机取20%作为评估输入
parameters.name: sampling_ratio

parameters.help_en: The start time of the trace data, in UTC format
parameters.name: start_time

Code.description_en: The internal error code. This parameter is returned only when an error occurs
Code.description_zh: 内部错误码。只在响应出错时被设置

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned only when an error occurs
Message.description_zh: 响应错误信息。只在响应出错时被设置
